evidence.observation: Smooth monotonic drift of ~1 °C over 20 min, consistent column profile with reboiler-to-condenser gradient
Reflux and distillate flows steady ~0.41-0.43 L/h
Stable differential pressures (~0.8 / ~2.0 mbar) and system pressure ~598 mbar
Reads ~496 °C, implausible for reboiler with overheads at ~68-86 °C; likely sensor scaling issue but stable and not affecting process channels

args.missing_evidence: A distillate composition measurement (e.g., GC of cut), plus verification/calibration of T701 reading to confirm it is a sensor-scaling artifact rather than real reboiler temperature.
